cases.name: missing readiness global does not block measured session
missing exporter global preserves recorder/readiness but blocks export
redacted preview and disposal never write before explicit confirmation
controller disposal, receipt binding, preview, and retry stay idempotent
navigation routes, fallback, readiness snapshot, and supplied measurement mount
optional Hub modules fail observably while required modules continue
actual Home Hub render completion records readiness
all nine Hub entrypoints include render-bound lifecycle/readiness calls

limitations: Physical Obsidian Mobile and native desktop evidence was not exercised.
Existing .obsidian drift and operator/device campaign remain human-only follow-up.
Actual full Hub/View execution was exercised for Home; all nine entrypoint lifecycle/readiness contracts were inspected against current source.

scenario.initialPreview: initial.controller.preview({ exportOptions: { destinationRoot, vaultRoot, approved: true } }) before any binding; expected missing_cold_warm.
scenario.boundLifecycle: session marks shell_mounted, data_scan/projection/dom_render start/end, markReady('knowledge', { status: 'deterministic', enabledAction: { id: 'knowledge.open', enabled: true } }), then controller.dispose(options) with explicit options.
scenario.exportOnlyPreview: controller.preview({ exportOptions: { destinationRoot, vaultRoot, approved: true } }) after dispose; no receiptOptions supplied.

priorAttempts.reason: The harness used unregistered selector g005-controller; rerun used registered selector knowledge.
dispose(options) finalized a receipt but did not bind it to controller preview state for export-only reuse.
